_comment: hdrsync P0: the Feed/Dashboard header narration. A new top-level `headerNarration` namespace in all 20 dictionaries. `stages.*` and `nudges` are ARRAYS and their lengths must match across locales per key (2 per stage, 6 nudges); `a11y` is a single string. The line renders in a TWO-LINE box at 14/21, so every line has a hard character ceiling: 46 in English, 58 in every locale. Do not raise the ceiling to fit a translation, shorten the English instead. NO PLACEHOLDERS, no em dashes, terminal punctuation on every line so a reader who catches exactly one line still gets a whole thought. THE `onDevice`, `starting` AND `nudges` POOLS MUST NEVER MENTION A SERVER, THE CLOUD, A NETWORK OR AN UPLOAD: they render during on-device runs where nothing leaves the phone, and `starting` renders before the engine is known. A test asserts that in English, with a control proving the matcher fires on the cloud pools. NO NUDGE MAY NAME A PIPELINE STEP (analyse/download/encrypt/group/summarise), or it reads as a status claim rather than a suggestion. Never edit the 20 dictionaries by hand.
